sections.heading: Render lane — Arctic sea at road height, defect (b): FIXED 2026-09-30

fields.label: Root cause
fields.value: The Clump_Filename prop loop pushed ONE IDENTITY instance per clump, on the assumption that a world clump's frame carries its own placement. SEA.DFF carries none (frame[0].pos == (0,0,0)), so Arctic's sea rendered as a single 60x60 m patch at road height and covered 77.96% of the start-grid view with water where the original has road.

fields.label: What the original does (per-track hook, not the asset, not COURSE.LUA)
fields.value: Table 0x005f33f8, stride 0x48 = {char name[0x10]; u32 Course_Id; void* slot[13]}; record "arctic" at 0x005f3488 with Course_Id 0 at 0x005f3498, slot 0 at 0x005f349c = 0x00448940. FUN_00448940 on course clump[2] ([course+0x10118] @ 0x0044899d): 0x004489bb sets translation.y = -4.1; 0x00448a47 clones 24 (RpClumpClone); 0x00448a65 / 0x00448a80 start X and Z at -150.0; 0x00448a6f / 0x00448a88 are 5x5; 0x00448aa2 is RwFrameTranslate; 0x00448aab / 0x00448ac1 step +60.0. => 25 tiles, X,Z in {-150,-90,-30,30,90}, Y = -4.1.

fields.label: Fix
fields.value: TrackRenderer.cpp:1715-1790 (commit a0f3004c), scoped to course_id_ == 0 && c.idx == 2 — the original's own Course_Id-keyed scope, so no other track can regress by construction. MASHED_NO_SEA_TILE=1 is the A/B revert. rva-lint allowlisted=122 NEW=0.
